description: Variable digestion caused by Vata dosha irregularity.
Sharp, intense digestion caused by Pitta dosha excess.
Sluggish digestion caused by Kapha dosha dominance.
Balanced digestion indicative of tridoshic equilibrium.
Light or disturbed sleep patterns associated with Vata imbalance.
Moderate sleep but easily awakened by light or heat, associated with Pitta.
Heavy, prolonged sleep associated with Kapha dosha.
Mental tendencies toward anxiety and fear due to elevated Vata and Rajas.
Mental tendencies toward anger, intensity, and sharp focus (Pitta and Rajas).
Mental tendencies toward withdrawal, stability, or lethargy (Kapha and Tamas).
